rows.summary: reads, writes, import and drift checked on a real device. The VLAN mode, 802.1Q group and PVID resources were not tried on this build (they are verified on 20250710; same protocol generation).

reads, imports and drift; the writes on unused ports (including mirror egress, unknown-unicast storm control and the VLAN mode, 802.1Q VLAN and PVID resources), the management address and the DHCP lease (the switch found again by its MAC address). LAG creation works as on 20230218 (group 1 takes ports 1-4, group 2 ports 5-8; see the `lag` page).
reads work, writes are refused unless `allow_unverified_firmware = true`; start with the read-only data sources
the client always performs the key exchange and has never been tried against the older login
